I found those charges. However, cleaning and damage fees are typically applied when there's an actual issue with the vehicle. Before I process refunds, I need to understand what happened—were these fees applied in error, or is there a dispute about the condition of the car?

If you believe these charges are unfair or incorrect, I'll need to escalate this to our team who can review the details with the driver. Let me know!
